# 2019 - International Year of Indigenous Language

> A UN-led global initiative dedicated to raising awareness of indigenous language endangerment and promoting cultural preservation through international cooperation and community action.

IYIL 2019 serves as a comprehensive platform for indigenous language advocacy, bringing together UNESCO, governments, and civil society organizations to document, preserve, and revitalize endangered languages worldwide. The initiative connects academic research, educational resources, digital tools, and community engagement to address the critical loss of linguistic diversity.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous languages
- Language preservation
- Language endangerment

## Core Initiative

- [2019 - International Year of Indigenous Language](https://en.iyil2019.org): UN initiative homepage raising awareness of indigenous languages and cultural diversity
- [About IYIL 2019](https://en.iyil2019.org/about/index.html): Explains IYIL2019 as UN cooperation mechanism for indigenous language preservation
- [Initiatives](https://en.iyil2019.org/initiatives/index.html): Global action plan and high-level events for indigenous language advocacy
- [Partnership](https://en.iyil2019.org/partnership/index.html): Partnership opportunities with UNESCO, governments, and civil society organizations

## Resources & Research

- [Resources Archive](https://en.iyil2019.org/resources): Archive of multilingual resources on endangered and indigenous languages
- [Academic Papers](https://en.iyil2019.org/resources_categories/academic-scientific-reports-and-articles-published-by-recognized-publishing-houses-and-research-institutes/index.html): Collection of peer-reviewed linguistic research on indigenous language preservation
- [Document Archives](https://en.iyil2019.org/resources_types/document/index.html): Documentation archive featuring indigenous language materials and research
- [Teaching Materials](https://en.iyil2019.org/resources_categories/teaching-material-and-lectures-published-by-accredited-education-institutions/index.html): Educational resources and curricula for indigenous language instruction
- [Digital Tools & Applications](https://en.iyil2019.org/resources_categories/electronic-applications-such-as-non-commercial-apps/index.html): Digital tools for language learning, translation, and oral history preservation

## Community Engagement

- [Get Involved](https://en.iyil2019.org/get-involved/index.html): Calls to action for community participation in language revitalization efforts
- [Share Your Work](https://en.iyil2019.org/share/index.html): Platform for submitting user-generated content and media contributions
- [Organization Registration](https://en.iyil2019.org/registration/organization-registration/index.html): Registration form for organizations to become IYIL2019 partners
- [User Registration](https://en.iyil2019.org/registration/user-registration/index.html): User account creation and profile setup for IYIL2019 participation

## Optional

- [Artistic Materials](https://en.iyil2019.org/resources_categories/artistic-items-posters-photos-event-outlines/index.html): Artistic and promotional materials for IYIL2019 cultural events
